messages:
aj: Heads up — seeing recurring GPU tail-latency spikes on rack-r12-usw2 around 10:30 UTC. Looks like one tenant is saturating NVLink and causing soft-preemptions for neighbours.

maria: +1. Telemetry shows NVLink retransmits and PCIe completion spikes. KV cache churn for other tenants spikes concurrently.

aj: Sample logs:```
2025-06-15T10:31:02Z r12-usw2 gpu0 nvlink: link-retries=423 errors=12
2025-06-15T10:31:02Z r12-usw2 gpu1 pci: completions-dropped=58
```

sanjay: Which tenant id? I can push a temporary qos tag or route it to a dedicated slice.

maria: tenant: acct-8423 (ml-batch-inference). They've been running long transformer batched jobs with large NVLink footprints.

aj: If we move them we'll need a fractional dedicated slice or preemptible carveout. Cost impact estimate ~+18% on that rack's reserved budget this month.

kelly: Can we instead do soft-ratecap on that tenant to reduce NVLink burstiness? That would be cheaper but may increase job latency.

infra-bot: alert: kv_cache_miss_rate(acct-8423) > 4x baseline for 24m :eyes:

maria: Soft-ratecap sounds good as short-term. Proposal: throttle concurrent streams to 60% and limit nvlink burst window to 2s via scheduler token-bucket.

aj: Agree. Implemented a canary policy in staging earlier. Command to enable (ops help):```
redwoodctl policies apply --tenant acct-8423 --policy throttle-concurrency=0.6 --burst-window=2s --scope rack=r12-usw2
```

ops: I'll run that now in r12-usw2 for a 20m canary and monitor telemetry.

(t+5m) ops: Applied throttle for acct-8423 on r12-usw2 canary. Realtime: nvlink retransmits down ~65%, neighbor tail-latency improved ~40%. :thumbsup:

maria: Nice. Can we also add a transient dedicated fractional slice if throttle isn't stable? Pre-approval from finance?

aj: Finance OK for temporary up to $2k/day. If throttle holds, we revert to guidance: add a tenant-level workload guide about batching patterns and recommended NVLink-friendly config.

kelly: Action items: sanjay will draft throttle rollback/playbook, taylor will run a 12h stability run, maria to update tenant-runbook with batching best-practices.

sanjay: I'll also add a metric card for nvlink_retransmits & neighbor_kv_miss_rate and an alert at 3x baseline.

taylor: Running 12h stability now. Will post summary at end.

maria: Long term: ops + infra to evaluate a fractional-dedicated pool scheduling feature that auto-carves short-lived slices for noisy tenants. We don't want manual firefights every week.

aj: Agreed. But short term — thumbs up on throttle + monitoring. If the throttle degrades tail-latency for any paying SLA tenant, escalate immediately.

infra-bot: note: postmortem template created -> /playbooks/pg-noisy-tenant.json

ops: Closing canary in 20m unless regressions. Thanks team.

aj: TY. Postmortem if it recurs.
